reason: The look-back coding is right: I re-derived it from poll.log. Header 07:48:12Z shows PENDING and 07:58:14Z shows COMPLETE 0.956; with the submit at 00:46:36Z that gives L in (7.03, 7.19] h. P is '-' (0.956 <= 0.957). L_hi is under the 8.0 h P-late threshold (04:51Z), so it is not turned into '?'. A-M1 is UNUSED and the freeze (9) SEC clause drops SEC. The DIS algebra also holds: '+' iff d_R >= 0.960, '-' iff d_R <= 0.955, '?' for 0.956..0.959. The finding still fails as a whole because its ACTION is stale. Its evidence stops at the 08:08:16Z header. CONTEXT.md '2026-09-29 08:19 UTC, A-M2 RULE (a)' was the user's choice in chat (commit 2fdf387), and it explicitly SUPERSEDES the 02:53Z (1) A-M2 function now that P is '-'. The new rule sends exp89s when exp89r is COMPLETE with no ERROR and displays >= 0.958 with L_hi <= 10.2 h, or >= 0.959 with L_hi <= 10.75 h. Otherwise A-M2 is UNUSED. The finding says 'Keep A-M2 = exp89s iff d_R >= 0.960 (... <= 10:50:28Z), else UNUSED'. Following that would wrongly veto exp89s on a 0.958 or 0.959 read, overriding a user decision. The time limit is also wrong: rule (a) uses a 10.2 h L_hi for a 0.958 read (the 10.2 h mark is about 10:17Z), not 10:50:28Z. The finding also misses the 08:23Z exp89t build and its pending slot-1 plan. Its information value is zero: the 07:59Z entry already logged these consequences.
fix: Drop the action line. At exp89r's first terminal header (latest the 11:00Z header), apply A-M2 RULE (a) from CONTEXT 08:19Z, not 02:53Z (1): exp89r COMPLETE, no ERROR, and display >= 0.958 with L_hi <= 10.2 h (or >= 0.959 with L_hi <= 10.75 h) -> nb_try exp89s,exp89q $KS "$M56S" with the G1/G2/G3/G5 guards, cutoff 11:30Z. Otherwise A-M2 is UNUSED. Log the R35-A3 B25 side line and the implied DIS estimate (d_R - 0.959 + 0.002) at that read. If the user says yes to exp89t for slot 1, re-check G2 used_today before the A-M2 submit.
realistic_gain: None on the LB. The only effect is avoiding a harm: if the finding's stale rule were followed, exp89s would be wrongly dropped on an exp89r read of 0.958 or 0.959, costing the single clean DIS read against exp85a.
